name: Crosswater (Sunriver high desert meadows)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours), same keys as pnw.json. Crosswater, Sunriver OR: bentgrass threaded through high-desert meadows and wetland where the Deschutes and Little Deschutes meet, under ponderosa and lodgepole pine. Bright bent greens and fairways; a meadow-gold rough (F0-F2); white sand; dark river water; pumice-grey paths. Trees in assets-src/trees_crosswater.py: ponderosa pine, lodgepole pine, quaking aspen and willow. The course chat's design, 2026-11-13. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
